input.label: Message
input.description.beginner: Type your question or message here. Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The name of the type. This is the primary identifier for the component.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A detailed description of what this type represents and how it should be used.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description.beginner: An icon to visually represent this type. Can be an emoji, icon name, or URL to an image.

image.label: Image
image.description.beginner: URL to an image that represents this type. Used for previews and visual identification.

variant.label: Variant
variant.description.beginner: Variant name for this type. Variants allow multiple configurations of the same type.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description.beginner: The unit of measurement used for this type (e.g., mm, m, ft).

url.label: URL
url.description.beginner: URL to a 3D model, image, or other resource representing this type.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A description of what this representation shows or how it should be used.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description.beginner: Tags to categorize and filter representations (e.g., 'detailed', 'simplified', 'lod1').

id.label: ID
id.description.beginner: Unique identifier for this port. Used to reference the port in connections.

family.label: Family
family.description.beginner: Port family name. Ports of the same family can connect to each other.

compatibleFamilies.label: Compatible Families
compatibleFamilies.description.beginner: List of other port families this port can connect to. Leave empty to allow all families.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A description of what this port represents and how it should be used for connections.

t.label: T
t.description.beginner: Position on the diagram ring (0-1). Controls where the port appears in the 2D diagram view.

x.label: X
x.description.beginner: X coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

y.label: Y
y.description.beginner: Y coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

z.label: Z
z.description.beginner: Z coordinate of the port direction vector. This defines which direction the port points in 3D space.

x.label: X
x.description.beginner: X position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.

y.label: Y
y.description.beginner: Y position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.

z.label: Z
z.description.beginner: Z position of the port in 3D space relative to the type's origin.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The name of the attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'material.wood', 'cost.labor').

value.label: Value
value.description.beginner: The value of the attribute. Leave empty for boolean attributes (presence = true).

definition.label: Definition
definition.description.beginner: Optional definition or documentation for this attribute. Can be text or a URL.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: Full name of the author or contributor.

email.label: Email
email.description.beginner: Email address for contacting the author.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The name of the design. This is the primary identifier for your composition.

description.label: Description
description.description.beginner: A detailed description of what this design represents and how it should be used.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description.beginner: URL or path to an icon that represents this design in listings and previews.

image.label: Image
image.description.beginner: URL or path to a preview image that showcases this design.

variant.label: Variant
variant.description.beginner: A variant identifier for different versions or configurations of this design.

view.label: View
view.description.beginner: The viewing perspective or camera angle for displaying this design.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description.beginner: The measurement unit used for all dimensions in this design (e.g., mm, cm, m).

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.description.beginner: The east-west position of this design's location in decimal degrees.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.description.beginner: The north-south position of this design's location in decimal degrees.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The full name of the person who contributed to this design.

email.label: Email
email.description.beginner: Contact email address for this author.

name.label: Name
name.description.beginner: The unique identifier for this attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., 'material.type').

value.label: Value
value.description.beginner: The value associated with this attribute. Leave empty to use as a category flag.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description.beginner: The measurement unit for this attribute's value (e.g., mm, kg, °C).

definition.label: Definition
definition.description.beginner: A URL or text that defines what this attribute means and how it should be interpreted.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description.beginner: The date and time when this design was first created.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description.beginner: The date and time when this design was last modified.

x.label: X
x.description.beginner: X diagram coordinate of the center of the piece in 2D layout space.

y.label: Y
y.description.beginner: Y diagram coordinate of the center of the piece in 2D layout space.
